mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, o.from_location_id, o.from_location_code, o.to_location_id, o.to_location_code, o.status, o.total_qty, o.remark, o.transfer_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM transfer_order o LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_no, warehouse_id, from_location_id, from_location_code, to_location_id, to_location_code, status, total_qty, remark, transfer_time, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM transfer_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE transfer_order SET status = 'COMPLETED', transfer_time = NOW(3), update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED' AND deleted = 0
